newsitem.title: UK: Northern Leisure sees rise in profits.
newsitem.headline: Northern Leisure sees rise in profits.

text.p: Northern Leisure Plc is confident that profits for the year ending August 31 1997 will be greater than those of the previous year after acquisitions boosted turnover, Chairman Alexander Cassels said.

Trading had been good since the start of the financial year. Much growth in turnover has come from five new outlets acquired since the start of the financial year at an aggregate cost of 9.4 million stg, Cassels said in remarks prepared for delivery at the annual general meeting on Monday.

"Turnover from dancing, now our sole activity, has been 47 percent higher in recent weeks than last year, and total income has been some 14 percent higher than in the same period last year," he said .
Cassels said like-for-like sales in the year to date were four percent higher than in the same period of 1995.

He said further acquisitions were under negotiation, but gave no details. Northern Leisure operates 31 dance outlets compared with 21 dance outlets and seven bowling centres at the same time last year.
By 1021 GMT, shares in Northern Lesiure had risen 4-1/2p to 169p.
